verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a set of AI-agent skills installed into Claude Code, or pasted into a chat as a mode. The user hands off whole tasks through its slash-command skills: reverse-engineering an app, planning the stack, rebuilding screens, adding a backend with /replica-backend, writing tests, scoring parity, and running preflight before shipping 'when you say go'. Missing for 10: the assistant itself is the host AI (Claude) rather than one native to the product, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration that the delegated workflows run as described.
